proposals.title: FIRST STOCKHOLDER PROPOSAL
proposals.proponent: John Chevedden, on behalf of James McRitchie
proposals.topic_summary: Requests board enable shareholders, without limits on group size, to aggregate shares to meet 3% for 3 years to nominate directors via proxy access (25% of authorized directors).
proposals.evidence: We recommend that you vote against the two stockholder proposals.

proposals.title: SECOND STOCKHOLDER PROPOSAL
proposals.topic_summary: Requests annual report disclosing Schwab's direct and indirect lobbying policies, payments, recipients, grassroots communications and oversight processes.
proposals.evidence: We recommend a vote against the second stockholder proposal.
